title: CGPA to Percentage Calculator
description: Convert your CGPA (10-point scale) to an equivalent percentage.

faqs.question: What formula is used?
faqs.answer: The commonly used India formula: Percentage = CGPA × 9.5.

faqs.question: Is this formula used by all universities?
faqs.answer: No — some institutions use their own conversion formula. Check your university's official conversion rule for formal use.
